_comment: Vehicle radio (Session 7). 3 stations. Music is made in code (placeholder, royalty-free because it is generated) unless a station lists 'tracks' = asset ids from data/assets.json (type sound, e.g. 'sound.radio.dhakaBeats1' → assets/audio/radio/dhaka-beats-1.mp3); then those files play in a loop instead. style = which code-made music (src/features/radio/music.js). bpm = tempo. key = base note in Hz. djEverySeconds = how often the DJ talks (shown at the top of the screen). Vehicle styles in noRadio have no radio (rickshaw, bicycle). Press R (or the 📻 button while driving) to change station / switch off.
